headline: Tiny and short-period today — a dawn log session at best.
today: Under 1.5ft of SSE with a light N dawn keeping it glassy, then SE cross-on moves in for the afternoon. If you want a mellow longboard roll, be out early on the push to the 10:04 high. Otherwise nothing here worth setting an alarm for.

daysToWatch.note: SE at a prime angle with a 9s pulse, total to 2.8ft. Dawn 11mph NE cross-off is the window before E wind takes over. Rockaway's the better call same day, but this works if you're closer.
